name: Korea Circuit Co., Ltd.
summary: Korea Circuit Co., Ltd. operates as a global producer and distributor of Printed Circuit Boards (PCBs). Their offerings encompass specialized circuit board types, including High-Density Interconnection (HDI) boards, advanced package substrates, and rigid-flexible PCBs. These essential components are widely integrated across numerous electronic applications, ranging from household devices like digital televisions and personal computers to various mobile and portable technologies. This includes products such as smartphones, IC modules, solid-state drives (SSDs), LCD displays, personal digital assistants (PDAs), and memory solutions. The company, established in 1964, has its corporate headquarters situated in Ansan, South Korea.
